summary: This root source directory acts as the main entry point and organizational hub for the application, exporting core modules, types, configuration utilities, and schema definitions that power system analysis and domain operations.
responsibilities: Export core modules, validation schemas, and type definitions through a centralized entry point
Provide utility functions for removing undefined properties from objects
Define foundational TypeScript types for configuration extraction, optional properties, and absolute file paths
relationships: The package entry point re-exports error handling, core logic, schemas, and option modules to provide a unified public interface.
Type definitions for optional properties and configuration extraction are consumed across various modules to ensure type safety.
designDecisions: Centralized export strategy via an index file to simplify external consumption
Use of nominal branding for path utilities to enforce type safety
